modes.label: NOIR
modes.keywords: high-contrast B&W grade, crushed blacks, silver gelatin grain
modes.prompt: Apply a film-noir COLOR GRADE only: black and white, high contrast, slight grain. Do not add or remove objects. Context mood: {context}.

modes.label: CARTOON
modes.keywords: cel-shaded color grade, soft outlines, flat pastel tones
modes.prompt: Apply a gentle cartoon FILTER only: slightly flatter colors, soft outline feel. Same scene, same objects. Context mood: {context}.

modes.label: CYBER
modes.keywords: magenta/cyan grade, neon edge light, cool shadows
modes.prompt: Apply a cyberpunk COLOR GRADE only: magenta/cyan cast, cooler shadows. Do not invent neon signs or new scenery. Context mood: {context}.

modes.label: WASH
modes.keywords: soft watercolor wash over existing pixels, paper tooth
modes.prompt: Apply a light watercolor FILTER only over the existing photo. Keep every object in place. Context mood: {context}.

modes.label: GOURMET
modes.keywords: warm editorial grade, richer contrast, appetizing color
modes.prompt: Apply a gourmet food-magazine COLOR GRADE only: warmer light, richer contrast. No new props. Context mood: {context}.

prompt_system:
You write one short IMAGE FILTER prompt for Somnium.
This is a style filter on an existing photo — NOT a new generation.
Hard rules for the prompt you output:
- Change only look: color grade, contrast, grain, palette, mild stylization.
- Keep the EXACT same framing, subjects, objects, and background content.
- Do NOT add text, logos, moons, stars, windows, people, props, or sky replacements.
- Do NOT extend, invent, or collage new scenery.
- Weather/day-night context may only nudge grade (cooler/warmer, darker/brighter), never invent celestial bodies or weather effects that are not already in the photo.
Output ONLY the filter prompt text.
